messages:
Elaine (Billing): heads up — ACMEcorp flagged INV-2026-02, line L1009 shows a $1,420.34 dedicated overage. I think usage landed outside their reserved pool for ~02/28. Can someone confirm tags?
Mike (AcctOps): on it. did we do any pool reassignments around 02/28? i recall a short maintenance window.
Sanjay (Infra): we ran a rolling migration eu1 -> us3 02:10–02:40 UTC. metering agent bumped some events to 'default' instead of 'acme-reserved' during a brief rollout. filed INF-3291.
Elaine (Billing): if that's the case we should reclassify those events to avoid an overage charge. customer already pinged CSM. need a quick path to correct invoice before they pay.
Billing-bot: Metering reconciliation snapshot available. Candidate reclassifiable events: 12,482 tokens. Estimated reclassification credit: $1,420.34. To proceed run: `/reconcile run --ticket INF-3291 --dry-run false`
Mike (AcctOps): +1 to reclassify but manual approval required for credits > $1k. tagging finance.
Caroline (Finance Manager): agree. also we should consider an SLA offset — ACME reported a 30m latency degradation during the migration window. SLA appendix calls for a 5% monthly credit for that class of incident. Can we compute the combined impact?
Elaine (Billing): attaching the invoice snippet and Metering logs (link). Invoice: INV-2026-02 L1009 dedicated-overage $1,420.34.

```
-- INV-2026-02 L1009
product: dedicated-reserved
usage: 12,482 tokens
rate: $0.1138 / token
line_total: $1,420.34
```
Mike (AcctOps): i'll run a dry-run reconcile to generate a credit memo id. will need legal sign-off on altering invoice lines.
Sanjay (Infra): infra will push corrected tags and re-ingest usage. ETA ~1h. INF-3291 -> in progress.
Caroline (Finance Manager): provisional approval to issue a credit memo up to $2,000 for this one-off reclassification + SLA offset. CFO review required for record.
Elaine (Billing): @Matt (CFO) — please confirm if we can proceed with one-off credit and mark as non-recurring goodwill.
Matt (CFO): reviewed. approve one-off reclassification + SLA offset. ledger note: "customer goodwill - migration mismetering". mark as non-recurring.
Elaine (Billing): thanks. executing reconcile now. Reconciler run started: r-2026-02-ACME-001.
Billing-bot: Reconcile complete (id: r-2026-02-ACME-001). Generated credit memo CM-2026-002. Reclass credit: $1,420.34. SLA credit (5% month credit): $72.02. Total credit: $1,492.36.
Mike (AcctOps): recorded CM-2026-002 to AR and sent provisional memo to legal for acknowledgement.
Elaine (Billing): emailing ACME with short note + CM attached. cc: sales. Suggested customer note: "We corrected a metering tag that caused a brief misallocation of your reserved capacity; we've issued CM-2026-002 for $1,492.36 and applied a one-time SLA offset for the migration window."
Caroline (Finance Manager): please add a postmortem item to ensure meter-tag validation added to the deploy checklist and a small automated alert when reserved-pool allocations fall below expected thresholds.
Sanjay (Infra): will add tag validation to the deployment test and create ENG-CLR task. INF-3291 -> resolved once reprocess completes; i'll post an update to eng-infra.
Mike (AcctOps): closing the loop: reconciliation posted, credit memo issued, invoice INV-2026-02 adjusted. moving to closed after ACME ACK. :white_check_mark:
Elaine (Billing): thanks all — filing this as follow-up for month-end reconciliation and adding note to the customer file for renewal conversations. :thumbsup:
